name: flaggems__thnn_fused_lstm_cell_backward_impl
description: Fused LSTM cell backward extracted from the FlagGems pytest and benchmark. gen_inputs first calls the vendor ATen forward operator so cx, cy, and workspace form one valid saved-state tuple, then creates grad_hy and grad_cy. The source-backed has_bias=True branch returns (grad_input_gates, grad_cx, grad_biases).
reference:
import torch


def gen_inputs(ctx, device):
    shape = tuple(ctx["cx__shape"])
    dtype = getattr(torch, ctx["cx__dtype"])
    batch_size, hidden_size = shape
    gate_shape = (batch_size, 4 * hidden_size)

    input_gates = torch.randn(gate_shape, dtype=dtype, device=device)
    hidden_gates = torch.randn(gate_shape, dtype=dtype, device=device)
    cx = torch.randn(shape, dtype=dtype, device=device)
    input_bias = torch.zeros(4 * hidden_size, dtype=dtype, device=device)
    hidden_bias = torch.randn(4 * hidden_size, dtype=dtype, device=device)

    hy, cy, workspace = torch.ops.aten._thnn_fused_lstm_cell(
        input_gates,
        hidden_gates,
        cx,
        input_bias,
        hidden_bias,
    )
    return {
        "grad_hy": torch.randn_like(hy),
        "grad_cy": torch.randn_like(cy),
        "cx": cx,
        "cy": cy,
        "workspace": workspace,
    }


def run(grad_hy, grad_cy, cx, cy, workspace, has_bias):
    return torch.ops.aten._thnn_fused_lstm_cell_backward_impl(
        grad_hy, grad_cy, cx, cy, workspace, has_bias
    )
